validation_notes: User guidance provided: I want a slightly open laptop. Low damping for smooth operation.
Method: One-Shot VLM (single query, no aggregation)

initial_joint_positions._reasoning: Joint_0 is a fixed joint connecting the base to the world, so its initial position is 0.0. Joint_1 is the revolute hinge for the screen. Based on the URDF's provided limits (lower: -1.85 rad, upper: 0.0 rad) and typical laptop hinge behavior, 0.0 rad is considered the fully closed position (screen flush with the base), and -1.85 rad (approximately 106 degrees) is the fully open position. To achieve a 'slightly open laptop' as requested, an intermediate value of -0.5 radians (approximately 28.6 degrees open) was chosen.
